**Finding: Compliant** — no redline proposed.

- **Clause 7.6 (p0031)** is an MFN that benefits us: Vendor warrants Customer's Fees will be no less favourable than those offered to similarly situated customers. Per the rule, a Vendor-granted MFN is welcome and left untouched.
- **No Customer-side MFN exists.** Sections 7 (Fees, Invoicing, Taxes) and 4 (Order Forms) contain no obligation for us to extend Vendor our best terms or match third-party offers, and targeted searches for MFN-style language ("no less favourable", "most favoured", "best price", "first refusal") surfaced nothing running against us.
- **Clause 12.3 (p0051)** reinforces the position, expressly confirming that "Customer has made no exclusivity, non-compete, most-favoured-customer, minimum-volume, or no-hire commitment."

The preferred playbook position (no MFN obligation on Customer) is already met, so no edit was required.
